chapters.name: The wrong name
chapters.story: Brenna finds a replacement name entered after the draw was sealed.

chapters.name: A second ledger
chapters.story: Millbrook received a different list of opponents. Compare the records.

chapters.name: Proof in the mud
chapters.story: Fight the disputed pairing and see who was expected to win.

chapters.name: First bell
chapters.story: Wilf will publish the discrepancy, but asks whose account to trust.

chapters.name: Broken ties
chapters.story: Several fighters blame a Millbrook apprentice for failed straps.

chapters.name: The ore route
chapters.story: Follow the repair order west to Ashmarket.

chapters.name: At the forge
chapters.story: Mara Flint identifies a forged inspection stamp.

chapters.name: Scapegoat bout
chapters.story: Win in the Foundry Pit to make the testimony impossible to ignore.

chapters.name: Across the bridge
chapters.story: The armour invoices point downriver.

chapters.name: Wrong measurements
chapters.story: Aldric shows you armour ordered for fighters who never existed.

chapters.name: Dockside contest
chapters.story: A visiting team carries the missing ledger page.

chapters.name: The river account
chapters.story: Take the evidence to the citadel clerk.

chapters.name: A travelling vote
chapters.story: Southmere clubs were promised a say in the next list.

chapters.name: The orchard lists
chapters.story: Earn the local fighters’ support in their arena.

chapters.name: The bailey record
chapters.story: Compare the local vote with the castle copy.

chapters.name: Who speaks
chapters.story: Present the contradiction before the delegates.

chapters.name: Northern orders
chapters.story: Kael has the training roster Voss altered.

chapters.name: Show your work
chapters.story: The garrison will share it after you hold your own in practice.

chapters.name: The company bout
chapters.story: Fight the garrison’s chosen side in Northwatch Yard.

chapters.name: Trail of signatures
chapters.story: Kael names the registrar and asks who should testify.

chapters.name: All witnesses
chapters.story: Bring the evidence to the Court; the live crowns are a separate challenge.

chapters.name: Voss answers
chapters.story: The registrar must face the people whose fights he changed.

chapters.name: The final lists
chapters.story: Win the NPC championship before the assembled clubs.

chapters.name: An open record
chapters.story: Have the result entered in the Great Hall.

chapters.name: The challenge
chapters.story: A rival captain calls you out.

chapters.name: First exchange
chapters.story: Meet the Reavers in the Dome.

chapters.name: Read their style
chapters.story: Defend, counter and fight again.

chapters.name: Settled in the lists
chapters.story: Finish the rivalry publicly.

chapters.name: Harvest road
chapters.story: Visit the farms and the woodcutters.

chapters.name: Missing timber
chapters.story: Ask both list crews about the carts.

chapters.name: Forest trial
chapters.story: Earn the charcoal burners’ trust.

chapters.name: A fair price
chapters.story: Report the true count to Hilda.

chapters.name: Shore promise
chapters.story: Irena explains a broken wager.

chapters.name: A witness
chapters.story: Question the shore herald.

chapters.name: Strand fight
chapters.story: Settle the disputed bout.

chapters.name: Keep the oath
chapters.story: Return to Irena.

chapters.name: The fuel line
chapters.story: Follow the ore road to the foundries.

chapters.name: Measured steel
chapters.story: Make a weapon or tool at the forge.

chapters.name: Workers’ match
chapters.story: Fight for the smiths in the Foundry Pit.

chapters.name: A master’s mark
chapters.story: Mara records the result.

chapters.name: Armour lane
chapters.story: See how the fitters work.

chapters.name: A bad batch
chapters.story: Repair damaged kit.

chapters.name: Dock claim
chapters.story: Win the waterfront bout.

chapters.name: The fitting book
chapters.story: Return the corrected order.

chapters.name: Stable lesson
chapters.story: Meet the school and rent or bring a horse.

chapters.name: On the course
chapters.story: Finish your first riding lesson.

chapters.name: Orchard bout
chapters.story: Join the local foot tournament.

chapters.name: Return the horse
chapters.story: Report to Edda.

chapters.name: Company orders
chapters.story: Join Kael in the yard.

chapters.name: The lesson
chapters.story: Earn a training rank through practice.

chapters.name: Company fight
chapters.story: Win at Northwatch.

chapters.name: Report back
chapters.story: Kael adds you to the company book.

chapters.name: The old law
chapters.story: Read the title record in the Great Hall.

chapters.name: The holders
chapters.story: Check the current crown display.

chapters.name: Historical bout
chapters.story: Prove that a title is won in the lists.

chapters.name: True succession
chapters.story: Celestine records the rule: defeat the holder.

chapters.name: A cold furnace
chapters.story: The night shift says someone cut the coal allotment after the roster was signed.

chapters.name: Charcoal trail
chapters.story: Ask the woods crew who collected the fuel and test their account in the clearing.

chapters.name: Cinders in the lists
chapters.story: The missing fuel paid a fighter to throw a Foundry Pit match. Win twice under the same rules.

chapters.name: A public tally
chapters.story: Put the corrected allotment on the clerk’s board where both shifts can read it.

chapters.name: Apprentice mark
chapters.story: Mara will not endorse a blade she has not watched you finish.

chapters.name: Anvil measure
chapters.story: The smiths want proof that a balanced weapon can survive repeated bouts.

chapters.name: The rival forge
chapters.story: A Stoneford order bears a false Ashmarket mark. Ask Aldric to compare the fittings.

chapters.name: Guild seal
chapters.story: Return the evidence and let Mara enter the true maker in the guild book.

chapters.name: The late barge
chapters.story: Tessa has a delivery docket with no recipient and a bridge toll with no boat.

chapters.name: Dock witnesses
chapters.story: The bridge crew saw the cargo moved during a tournament. Earn their account.

chapters.name: The empty crate
chapters.story: Aldric can identify the armour fasteners found where the shipment should have been.

chapters.name: Ward record
chapters.story: Take the revised manifest to Tessa before another fighter is charged for the loss.

chapters.name: Measure twice
chapters.story: Aldric fits armour by observing how you move and defend.

chapters.name: Hard use
chapters.story: Take the fitted harness through two Bridge Lists bouts.

chapters.name: Field repair
chapters.story: Return with the damaged parts and mend them under the platewright’s eye.

chapters.name: Fitter’s book
chapters.story: Aldric records the dimensions so future repairs match the original harness.

chapters.name: The old boundary
chapters.story: Lysa shows you where the orchard was promised to the riding school.

chapters.name: A rider’s account
chapters.story: Edda knows why the boundary moved. Train with her before you ask.

chapters.name: Orchard witnesses
chapters.story: The local fighters will testify after you join their lists twice.

chapters.name: Restore the line
chapters.story: Bring both accounts to Lysa for the public register.

chapters.name: Saddle check
chapters.story: Edda asks you to check the horse before the long circuit.

chapters.name: Across the realm
chapters.story: Carry the school’s messages to the woods and river without abandoning the route.

chapters.name: The return leg
chapters.story: Finish at the orchard, then prove you can still fight after travel.

chapters.name: Rider’s ledger
chapters.story: Edda records the distance and who completed the circuit.

chapters.name: The night roster
chapters.story: The company scribe finds a missing patrol between two signed watches.

chapters.name: Patrol route
chapters.story: Trace the road back toward the old castle and question its marshal.

chapters.name: Yard assessment
chapters.story: Kael tests whether the absent patrol was replaced by fighters ready for duty.

chapters.name: Name the watch
chapters.story: Restore the missing patrol to the scribe’s roll.

chapters.name: First discipline
chapters.story: Kael asks you to learn a drill and show its value under pressure.

chapters.name: Hold the line
chapters.story: Defend the company standard through repeated yard bouts.

chapters.name: Carry the lesson
chapters.story: Visit the Foundry Pit, then bring its fighters’ techniques back north.

chapters.name: The cadet roll
chapters.story: Report what should be taught next to Kael and the scribe.

entries.name: Your first day in the realm
entries.summary: A route from your first quest to your first crafted tool.

sections: Visit Marshal Brenna for Crooked Draw, the first main quest. Follow each objective in order and claim the chapter reward to unlock the next.
Visit Coach Sigrid at the Fairground Training Yard. Practise clean hits, defence and movement before entering a regional arena.
Look around the Fairground edges for copper, ash, herbs and berries. Walk up to a node, interact, then time your three swings in the green zone.
Take ore and fuel to the smith’s furnace. Smelt ingots and forge better gathering tools. Each recipe lists its level and ingredients.
Inspect and repair equipment between bouts. Higher grades of weapon work are in Ashmarket; armour fitting is in Stoneford; advanced training is in Northwatch.
